description: A lookalike and neither a replica nor an original; Aircraft No. 001 built by volunteers from Wright-Patterson AFB starting in 1975 with first flight in 1982 and modelled on the heavily modified non-flying Model B in the Air Force Museum; steel structure at 3400 lb empty against 1400 lb for the original with ailerons instead of wing warping and Lycoming HIO-360 power; nicknamed the Iron Bird and now retired from flying and displayed in the organisation's hangar museum
aliases: Wright Model B lookalike; Iron Bird; Brown Bird

description: A lookalike and not a replica; second-generation Wright Model B lookalike built at the organisation's Miamisburg hangar with wings built to specification by EAA Chapter 5 of Middlefield Ohio; first flew in autumn 2021 with high-speed taxi and pattern testing through 2022 and a full display season in 2023; this is the flying aircraft and the Brown Bird is now the static one; no registration is published for this airframe so the tail number is deliberately blank
aliases: Wright Model B lookalike; White Bird
